userDirection: Add soft shadows or blurred halo layers around skill buttons, with Honor of Kings as visual inspiration.
ownership: Project-original procedural textures exported with existing Resvg/Pillow. The official screenshot was viewed only as visual reference and is not part of either texture. No model generation or new dependencies.

reference.previewWorld: Project runtime screenshots hud-skill-v16-outdoor.png and hud-skill-v16-hidpi.png
reference.previewStatus: Isolated concept and actual runtime verification are recorded separately; runtime evidence is listed below.
reference.visualInterpretation: Diffuse dark separation from world terrain, with restrained perimeter haze. Official artwork is reference-only and is not included in either new texture.

construction: Two reusable transparent sprite layers behind each accepted v16 face: broad dark ambient/contact shadow plus subtle neutral-champagne perimeter haze. Soft alpha fades avoid hard circles or panels.

assets.description: Neutral dark ambient/contact shadow; baked lower weighting. Place centered behind the skill face.
Restrained desaturated champagne-gray soft rim halo. Centered; 0.15 alpha peak near the face edge, with no solid line or face artwork.

sampling: Runtime verified all14 soft-layer sprites reuse 10-level trilinear mipmapped non-atlased textures. Cocos-generated metadata retained with mipmaps enabled.

artReview.isolated: Asset task inspected the 58/86 previews and alpha fade; parent reviewed isolated-preview-v17.png and approved first-pass strength for runtime integration without brightening. Geometry and alpha frozen.
artReview.runtime: Actual desktopDPR2, mobile844x390 and narrow667x375 captures inspected. Diffuse contact shadow and subtle edge haze separate buttons from terrain; frame scrolls and icons stay crisp; adjacent mobile shadows leave visible gaps without hard clipped edges.

validation.build: Cocos Creator3.8.8 web-mobile hud-soft-depth-v17 completed using isolated current-assets project; UI source bytes match.
validation.hitTargets: All7 hit/face dimensions equal v16; center hit true, visible shadow outside hit remains non-UI.
validation.inputLayers: Soft sprites have no Button, BlockInputEvents or touch listener; attached to pressed face before frame.

deployment.mainStatus: A concurrent concept-2d build replaced the initial deployment while a startup probe was loading. After that build completed, a fresh main-page probe reported ready=true, failure empty and soft shadow present; zero page errors.
deployment.independentStatus: Ready with both soft layers active, 10 mip levels and zero page errors. Separate output keeps this review link independent of concept-2d rebuilds.
